items.description: Bonavide (Pty) Ltd. is a technology and information company based in Sinoville, on Sefako Makgatho Drive, operating under the slogan "Innovation that flies." Founded in 2016, the company specialises in surveying, GIS and 3D modelling applications, working with customers to identify and create tailored solutions before implementing and continuously refining them for better efficiency, accuracy and cost. Its specialties include photogrammetric surveying, volumetric surveying, qualitative aerial surveys and quantity surveys, along with GIS, mapping and contour mapping. The company also carries out aerial photography, asset inspections, infrastructure inspections and construction monitoring. Bonavide serves customers across several industries in Southern Africa, including mining, agriculture, tourism and various infrastructure sectors, operating as a small, privately held business with a team of between two and ten employees.

Bosal is an automotive and industrial parts manufacturer whose South African arm, Bosal Afrika, runs its research and development centre from Koedoespoort, Pretoria. The wider Bosal Group was established in 1923 in Alkmaar and remains a family-owned, Dutch-registered company, with its head office now in Lummen, Belgium, and a global network that in 2020 spanned 16 manufacturing plants, 12 distribution centres and 7 R&D centres generating roughly 350 million euros in turnover. Bosal Afrika supplies automotive and industrial products across South Africa, including to major car manufacturers and leading industrial conglomerates, through what it describes as an extensive national footprint. The Koedoespoort R&D facility is equipped to verify that products meet government legislation, OEM specifications and SABS standards, and it follows a scientific approach to designing and developing exhaust systems, towbars and styling items for the local market.

Bosele Consulting is a fully Black-owned quantity surveying, project management and engineering consultancy established in 2012. The company's quantity surveying arm estimates and manages costs on construction projects, producing detailed cost estimates and continually monitoring spending so that work stays within budget. Its project management service oversees the entire construction process from initial planning through to execution, with project managers working closely with clients to keep projects on schedule, within budget and to the required quality standards. Bosele Consulting's engineering services span the full process from conceptual design to precise execution, drawing on expertise across civil, structural, mechanical and electrical engineering. The firm operates beyond its home base, with branch offices extending into other South African provinces including the Eastern Cape, Free State and KwaZulu-Natal, and describes its approach as building clients' visions with professionalism, ethics and up-to-date methodologies throughout every project.

Brandway SA is a digital marketing and web design agency based at Garsfontein Road in Ashlea Gardens, Pretoria, describing its approach as combining creative design, structured strategy and performance marketing to build brand identity. The agency designs websites intended to convert visitors into leads and improve search engine visibility across devices, and runs social media services built around strategic posting, branded designs and community engagement meant to grow reach and generate enquiries each month. Its corporate design work covers professional profiles, stationery and marketing assets intended to present a business consistently and strengthen brand recognition. Brandway SA also builds ecommerce stores with secure payments and product-level SEO set-up, aimed at smoother shopping experiences, and offers corporate photography as part of its wider range of branding and digital marketing services for growth-focused businesses.

Brooklyn Travel is a South African travel agency with a branch in Valhalla, Pretoria, specialising in tailor-made travel experiences for individuals, groups and organisations. Its holiday packages cover international travel, domestic getaways, regional adventures and island holidays, ranging from tropical escapes and cultural adventures to food-and-wine journeys and adventure trips for thrill-seekers. The agency also serves a varied client base: it arranges group tours and travel logistics for educational institutions and sports teams, builds specialised itineraries for non-profit organisations' humanitarian work, provides corporate travel solutions for small and medium enterprises in sectors such as agriculture, pharmaceuticals, engineering and construction, and puts together travel packages for embassies' official and diplomatic missions. For corporate clients, Brooklyn Travel offers customised travel planning backed by experienced consultants, along with access to exclusive deals and discounts for SMEs and corporate accounts.

Byrograph positions itself as providing innovative, safe solutions and advice with precision and relevance, aiming to maximise the value it delivers to customers while helping organisations modernise and secure their operations across both private and public sectors.

items.description: Camino Living is a Montana Park retailer with more than 20 years of experience supplying and installing a wide range of fireplace and braai brands, alongside a dedicated pizza oven and outdoor-living division. Its product range spans freestanding, multifuel, double-sided, wall-mounted and built-in fireplaces, gas fireplaces and drop-in gas grates, open wood fireplaces, bio-ethanol burners, suspended fireplaces and related accessories such as flue pipes, damper units and heater stove glass. On the braai side, it stocks built-in, combo, freestanding, gas, mobile, spit and table braais, along with braai accessories and cooking extractor hoods. The business also sells wood ovens, refurbished anthracite stoves, pizza ovens and outdoor and camping equipment such as boma fire pits and gas geysers. Camino Living offers installation for customers who have already bought a fireplace elsewhere, and draws on its construction background for renovation work, taking on jobs of any size.

Camspec Engineering is a precision engineering and toolmaking business based in Klerksoord, Rosslyn, offering machining, fabrication and engineering services for industrial and specialist applications across Gauteng. Its core services include milling and turning, toolmaking, design and drawings, TIG welding, and broader engineering and manufacturing work. The company manufactures replacement components from an existing sample, drawing or specification, and produces punches, dies, shafts, gears and other specialised tooling, combining traditional engineering skills with modern manufacturing techniques. Camspec works on both one-off and repeat milling jobs, asking customers for details such as what the component is or does, the quantity required, whether a drawing or sample is available, and the required timeline, before issuing a quote. The business describes itself as committed to on-time delivery, keeping customers informed throughout a job, and providing practical support from initial enquiry through to the completed part.

Cars Com II is a used car dealership located on Steve Biko Road in Wonderboom South, Pretoria. The dealership markets itself around offering quality vehicles at guaranteed prices, aiming to make finding the right car simple for buyers across a range of budgets, ages and lifestyles. Alongside its vehicle sales, Cars Com II provides vehicle finance assistance to help customers fund a purchase, and offers an option for current owners to sell their vehicle for cash, effectively allowing a trade-in or straight sale route for people looking to move on from their current car. The business presents its showroom as catering to a broad customer base rather than one specific type of buyer, and attributes repeat business to the quality of the vehicles and service it provides year after year.

Casa De Bronze is a manufacturer, wholesaler and importer of gas equipment and accessories, along with brass, steel and PEX plumbing products, operating from a factory at Tannery Industrial Park in Silverton, Pretoria. The business designs and produces its own brass and steel items in-house, working from relationships with suppliers that it says let it offer competitive pricing, and it emphasises a fast turnaround supported by its own equipment and delivery fleet. Casa De Bronze supplies fittings to customers across South Africa from its Silverton factory, covering product lines such as gas cages, gas equipment and accessories, and PEX and brass plumbing components, as well as general steel products. Customers can request a free quote for custom brass or steel work. The business operates Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, and on Saturdays from 8am to 1pm.

CEN Group is a private security company that positions itself around strategic risk mitigation for high-stakes environments, working with international corporations and JSE-listed enterprises. Its approach is framed around anticipating threats before they materialise rather than only responding once an incident has occurred, with an emphasis on protecting both physical assets and an organisation's reputation. Beyond providing protection and threat-prevention services directly to clients, CEN Group runs its own training academy, through which it develops personnel for the security operations it undertakes. The company sets out dedicated service lines for the industries it covers and a formal process for organisations wanting to join its security operations.

Centacc Accounting is a modern accounting firm based at Festival Street in Hatfield, Pretoria, founded in 2013 to provide tailored accounting and business services to both private and public-sector clients. Centacc's tax planning and returns team tracks changes to South African tax legislation as implemented by SARS, and its business advisory service offers strategic guidance and practical solutions aimed at helping client businesses operate more effectively and profitably.
